anaglyph.definition:
n. moving or still pictures in contrasting colors that appear three-dimensional when superimposed
n. anything carved in low relief

anaglyphic.definition: a. related to anaglyphs or anaglyphy

anaglyphical.definition:
a. Pertaining to the art of chasing or embossing in
   relief; anaglyptic; -- opposed to diaglyptic or sunk work.

anaglyphy.definition: n. the process of producing pictures in contrasting colors that appear three-dimensional when superimposed and viewed through spectacles with one red and one green lens

anaglypta.translation: 安那利普特（凸纹）壁纸；浮雕壁纸

anaglyptas.translation: (anaglypta 的复数)  安那利普特（凸纹）壁纸；浮雕壁纸

anaglyptic.definition: a related to anaglyphs or anaglyphy
anaglyptic.translation: a. 浅浮雕的, 浅浮雕装饰的

anaglyptical.definition: a related to anaglyphs or anaglyphy
anaglyptical.translation: a. 浅(型)浮雕的；浅浮雕装饰的

anaglyptics.definition: n. The art of carving in low relief, embossing, etc.

anaglyptograph.definition:
n. An instrument by which a correct engraving of any
   embossed object, such as a medal or cameo, can be executed.
anaglyptograph.translation: 在平面上制作突出于表面的版画、蚀刻、雕刻等的机械装置

anagnoic.translation: [医] 窒息解除的, 呼吸的

anagnostopoulos.translation: [人名] 阿纳格诺斯托普洛斯

anagoge.definition: n. a mystical or allegorical interpretation (especially of Scripture)
anagoge.translation:
n. 神秘解释
[医] 理想精神[内容]

anagogic.definition: a. based on or exemplifying anagoge
anagogic.translation: [医] 理想精神的, 神秘的

anagogical.definition:
a. Mystical; having a secondary spiritual meaning; as, the
   rest of the Sabbath, in an anagogical sense, signifies the repose of
   the saints in heaven; an anagogical explication.
anagogical.translation: （对《圣经》等所作的）神秘解释的

anagogically.translation: adv. （对<圣经>等所作的）神秘解释地

anagogics.definition:
n. pl. Mystical interpretations or studies, esp. of the
   Scriptures.

anagrammatic.translation: a. 改缀文字的；字谜的

anagrammatism.definition: n. The act or practice of making anagrams.

anagrammatized.definition: v read letters out of order to discover a hidden meaning
anagrammatized.translation: v. 作拼字游戏( anagrammatize的过去式和过去分词 )
